.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.- The petitioner, who claims to be a public spirited citizen, seeks a writ to the local administration to retrieve 4-0 acres of public land in Survey No. 502, Deh Kandiaro from encroachment made by the private respondents. On the other hand, learned counsel for the intervenors submits that said land is private property of the intervenors which has also remained subject matter of litigation between private parties. Though an inspection report has also been submitted by the Assistant Commissioner Kandiaro with regards to said property, suffice to say that writ jurisdiction is not intended to probe into title to immovable property. The question whether any public property has been encroached, falls within the domain of the Anti-Encroachment Tribunal. The petition is therefore dismissed.
J U D G E J U D G E Abdul Basit
